_comment: Compose with: node tools/screenshots/compose.mjs apps/maze/store/screenshots.json apps/maze/store/screenshots/en-US. Raw captures come from app-verify (apps/maze/qa) and are copied into store/raw. The sampler leads, per the spec's 4.3 note that the listing opens on the daily and the days running, never a bare grid. The background is linen going to indigo thread; the font is the app's own New York.
